title: Bengaluru-based KreditBee, a digital lending service for personal and business loans and more, raised a $280M Series E at a $1.5B post-money valuation (Harsh Upadhyay/Entrackr)
summary: Harsh Upadhyay / Entrackr: Bengaluru-based KreditBee, a digital lending service for personal and business loans and more, raised a $280M Series E at a $1.5B post-money valuation — Digital lending platform KreditBee has raised $280 million in its Series E round at a post-money valuation of $1.5 billion.
